answer: Every identity posts a stake before it can attest, and the batch is voided when the grading panel turns out to share one subnet. Duplicates are caught by replaying the submission, not by comparing labels. Example: a 300-clone farm locks 300 stakes, then watches one non-diverse panel wipe an epoch of rewards. That is a steep summit for a saffron-sized payout, and only the crystal of a clean history keeps the stake unlocked.
